figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, mere nominal fulfillment of a desire
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ইচ্ছা পূরণের নামে শুধু পিত্তরক্ষা করল।
এটা তো পিত্তরক্ষা, আসল সুখ কোথায়?
example_sentences_in_english: He only provided pitta raksha in fulfilling her wish.
This is just pitta raksha; where's the real satisfaction?
history: References Ayurvedic concept of 'pitta' (bile) as one of the three doshas, implying minimal or superficial relief.
note: Idiom draws from traditional medicine, used ironically in modern Bengali speech.
